channel.title: The Living Church - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Living Church (livingchurch.org)

item.title: One of the largest U.S. Episcopal churches plans $58M Houston expansion
item.description: Officials say it's the church's first major capital project in 32 years.

item.title: All In: Immersive Worship for Everybody - The Living Church
item.description: Christian worship is sometimes heavy on words and inaccessible. Are there ways to make worship more engaging for those with disabilities?

item.title: Bishop Ashley Null Worships with Pope Leo in Algeria - The Living Church
item.description: Pope Leo celebrated the Mass on his second day in Algeria, in the earliest days of his visit to Africa.

item.title: Letters, 4/24 - The Living Church
item.description: TLC readers reflect on the diaconate, confession, and Deism.

item.title: Filipino, Mexican Food Unifies San Diego Parish - The Living Church
item.description: A predominantly immigrant church in National City finds common ground in pancit and pozoles.

item.title: The Good, the Bad, and the Ugly (Palm Sunday, Year A)
item.description: The sustenance for the journey to the Promised Land would not be manna, the bread of angels, or matzah, the bread of flight, but the broken body of the Lord.

item.title: Quakers Republish Historic Book to Honor Abp. Mullally - The Living Church
item.description: Archbishop Sarah Mullally is part of a long lineage of English female preachers that includes Margaret Fell, the cofounder of Quakerism, who wrote the first lengthy defense of women’s preaching.

item.title: The ‘Transitional’ Diaconate Is Not a Thing - The Living Church
item.description: Deacons are deacons regardless of whether they are also to be ordained priest. The terms "transitional" and "vocational" are problematic.

item.title: A Warm Welcome from Latin America for Archbishop Mullally - The Living Church
item.description: From Cuba through Mexico, Central America, Brazil, Colombia, and Ecuador, lay people and clergy from the various Anglican communities celebrated.

item.title: Bishops, Deans Ponder Future of Theological Education - The Living Church
item.description: Bishops met for three days with seminary deans and discussed the Nairobi-Cairo Proposals, strategic plans, and prayer book revision.

item.title: Christian Doctrines and Accessibility for the Disabled - The Living Church
item.description: Disability theology is no secular intrusion with a few vague attempts at Christian jargon. Rather, it's an outworking of Christian doctrine.

item.title: Power Made Perfect in Weakness - The Living Church
item.description: Part of our series on disabilities and the church, a parent reflects on God's power in our weakness and his child with Down syndrome.

item.title: 5/10 Issue Online - The Living Church
item.description: The May 10 Spring Books &amp; Education issue of The Living Church is available online to registered subscribers.

item.title: TLC Wins Two Polly Bond Awards - The Living Church
item.description: TLC reporter Caleb Maglaya Galaraga has won one Award of Merit in Episcopal Communicators’ Polly Bond Awards, and TLC’s podcast has won another.

item.title: Awakening Faith in Houston - The Living Church
item.description: Awaken 2025, a weekend gathering, drew hundreds of parishioners of the Church of St. John the Divine in Houston with the goal of spreading spiritual awakening, renewal, and rededication.
